coverage: '20+ Coding Patterns to crack any Coding Interviews', a 26-page promotional slide deck by DesignGurus.io (no author, copyright or licence line; the last slide points to its paid Grokking courses). After a 2-slide intro, each of the 23 Grokking patterns gets one slide: a one-sentence usage cue, the data structures involved and 2-3 sample problem names. No explanations, diagrams, complexity notes or solutions. The pattern list is identical to our algo catalog's patterns and is a subset of DesignGurus' free online 41-pattern cheat sheet. Local PDF only.

refs.title: 20+ Coding Patterns (whole deck)
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: 26-slide DesignGurus promo deck: the 23 Grokking patterns, one slide each with a usage cue, data structures and 2-3 sample names. Our catalog's pattern list; no teaching content.

refs.title: Sliding Window
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: when to keep a window over an array/string, structures used; names two samples (K distinct chars substring, fruit baskets). No explanation or code.

refs.title: Islands (Matrix Traversal)
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: grid traversal cue plus three sample names (count islands, flood fill, cycle in a grid); we have Flood Fill. No method shown.

refs.title: Two Pointers
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: one-line cue for two moving indices; samples are squaring a sorted array, Dutch flag and minimum window sort. Names only.

refs.title: Fast & Slow Pointers
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: hare-and-tortoise cue; samples are list middle (we have it), happy number and cycle in a circular array. Names only.

refs.title: Merge Intervals
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: overlapping-interval cue; samples are conflicting appointments and minimum meeting rooms (we have the latter). Names only.

refs.title: Cyclic Sort
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: values-in-a-known-range cue; samples are all missing numbers, all duplicates (we have both) and first K missing positives.

refs.title: In-place Reversal of a LinkedList
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: reverse links without extra memory; samples are reversing every K nodes and rotating a list, both already in our catalog.

refs.title: Breadth-First Search
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: level-by-level tree/graph traversal cue; samples are level order, minimum depth (we have both) and connecting level siblings.

refs.title: Depth-First Search
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: depth-first tree/graph cue; samples are path matching a digit sequence and counting paths for a sum (our Path Sum III).

refs.title: Two Heaps
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: split elements into a min half and max half; samples are running median (we have it) and next interval. Names only.

refs.title: Subsets
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: permutations/combinations cue; samples are case-change permutations (our Letter Case Permutation) and generalized abbreviations.

refs.title: Modified Binary Search
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: search over sorted data; samples are ceiling of a number and bitonic array maximum. Names only, no invariant discussion.

refs.title: Bitwise XOR
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: XOR trick cue; samples are two single numbers and flip-and-invert image, both already in our catalog. Names only.

refs.title: Top 'K' Elements
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: top/smallest/most-frequent K cue; samples are K closest points and maximum distinct elements, both in our catalog.

refs.title: K-way Merge
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: several sorted lists cue; samples are Kth smallest across M lists and in a sorted matrix, both in our catalog.

refs.title: 0/1 Knapsack
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: pick-each-item-once under capacity; samples are equal subset partition and minimum subset sum difference (both ours).

refs.title: Unbounded Knapsack
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: reuse-items-freely variant; samples are rod cutting and coin change (we have Coin Change). Names only.

refs.title: Fibonacci Numbers
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: next value depends on the last few; samples are staircase and house thief (our House Robber). Names only.

refs.title: Palindromic Subsequence
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: palindrome optimisation cue; samples are longest palindromic subsequence and min deletions to make a palindrome.

refs.title: Longest Common Substring
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: best part of one or more sequences; samples are max-sum increasing subsequence and edit distance (both ours).

refs.title: Topological Sort
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: order items with dependencies; samples are task scheduling and alien dictionary (we have the latter). Names only.

refs.title: Backtracking
refs.subject: algo
refs.summary: Slide: build incrementally, abandon dead ends; samples are combination sum and sudoku solver, both already in our catalog.

refs.title: Multi-threaded
